run_render_cams_cli: run the render_cams CLI to render offscreen images from a mujoco model using specified camera names
render_camera_offscreen: render offscreen images from a list of mujoco cameras at a specified width, height, and device id
create_render_images: create offscreen render images from a mujoco simulation using multiple camera names and save as jpeg files
run_render_with_custom_size: run the render_cams module with custom image width and height parameters for mujoco camera rendering
test_render_camera_offscreen: test the render_camera_offscreen function with a mujoco sim, camera list, and custom dimensions
